---
title: "Côte d’Ivoire department analysis | SURGO × Manitoba"
output:
  html_document:
    template: ../../../analysis/common/report.html
    theme: null
    mathjax: null
    self_contained: false
    keep_md: false
    pandoc_args: ["--wrap=none"]
params:
  join_dir: ""
  cache_dir: "data/cache"
  input_zip: !r Sys.getenv("SURGO_MANITOBA_INPUT_ZIP", "")
  work_dir: "output/aggregate_reports/cotedivoire"
  python: !r Sys.getenv("SURGO_MANITOBA_PYTHON", "python3")
  prepared_fragment: ""
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE)
root <- normalizePath("../../..", mustWork = TRUE)
source("Cote_dIvoire_analysis_aggregate.R")
fragment <- params$prepared_fragment
if (!nzchar(fragment)) {
  if (!nzchar(params$join_dir) && !nzchar(params$input_zip))
    stop("Supply join_dir or input_zip, or render through R/run_aggregate_reports.R")
  report <- build_cotedivoire_aggregate(root, params$join_dir, params$cache_dir,
    params$work_dir, params$python, params$input_zip)
  fragment <- report$fragment
}
```

```{r report, results='asis'}
cat("```{=html}\n")
cat(readLines(fragment, warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), sep = "\n")
cat("\n```\n")
```
